_doc: The installer's screens (src/testos/installer_logic.c, inst_screen_lines()), hand-checked; lines as screens.json writes them. Each case gives the phase, the version shown, the target slot index (0 Slot 1, 1 Slot 2), the lock, the last write's code (255 none), the OS state, the trial, a hold under way (digit, fill 0-1000, seconds left; digit 0 none), the key check's keys pressed (keys_seen: bit 0 com, bit 1 the recovery key, M4 on the OP-XY; 0 when absent), the device (0 OP-XY, 1 OP-1F; 0 when absent), the key check's last other key (last_key, 255 none), the first stage's n and c (fs_n, fs_c), and for the survey's screen its facts (survey; slot_bits are INST_SV_*), as waffle/board/installer.h numbers them.

cases.name: keys
lines: head:Press com, then M4, to go on
These two presses are the key check.
item:8 End: the install is then not offered

cases.name: keys_com_pressed
lines: head:Press com, then M4, to go on
These two presses are the key check.
item:8 End: the install is then not offered

cases.name: locked
lines: Nothing was written to the SPI flash.
Results: check.txt on the USB disk, or the page.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: locked_no_os
lines: Nothing was written to the SPI flash.
Results: check.txt on the USB disk, or the page.
To leave, write an OS from the developer menu.

cases.name: ready
lines: A trial first: the new bootloader starts once.
Your bootloader stays selected until you keep it.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

lines: A trial first: the new bootloader starts once.

dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: ready_held
lines: A trial first: the new bootloader starts once.
Your bootloader stays selected until you keep it.

cases.name: trial_written
lines: ok:The new bootloader starts once, at the next start.
1. Switch off, then on: its boot menu shows.
2. Switch off, then on again: this installer
dim:Until then your bootloader stays selected.

lines: head:The trial reached the boot menu
item:8 Leave, keep the old one
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: commit_ready_no_os
lines: head:The trial reached the boot menu
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: done
lines: dim:Boot menu: hold com while switching on.
dim:Recovery menu: hold Power + M4 while switching on.

cases.name: done_no_os
lines: dim:Boot menu: hold com while switching on.
dim:Recovery menu: hold Power + M4 while switching on.

cases.name: done_os_found

dim:Recovery menu: hold Power + M4 while switching on.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: done_os_failed
lines: error:A write to the eMMC's boot partitions failed.
dim:Boot menu: hold com while switching on.
dim:Recovery menu: hold Power + M4 while switching on.

cases.name: failed_trial
lines: error:What was written does not read back the same.
The unit keeps its bootloader selected.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: failed_commit
lines: error:A read, erase or program of the flash failed.
Both slots hold a bootloader that starts.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: trial_failed
lines: head:The trial did not reach the boot menu
error:The new bootloader started; no boot menu showed.
Nothing was kept: your bootloader stays selected.
dim:   Hold key to make selection

cases.name: trial_spent
lines: head:The trial did not reach the boot menu
error:The trial start did not run the new bootloader.
Nothing was kept: your bootloader stays selected.
armed:8 Leave without installing	Hold `8` for 5 s
